text: 6年来最大单日涨幅！国际油价再燃通胀担忧，全球央行“鹰派”风险上升 国际油价飙升重新点燃了市场对通胀风险的忧虑，并已向更广泛的金融市场蔓延。
text_en: Biggest single-day gain in 6 years! International oil prices reignite inflation fears, global central banks face 'hawkish' risk. Surging oil prices renew market worries about inflation risks, spreading to broader financial markets.
